BEGIN_SIGNATURE:M007
@HasDerivAt.inner : ∀ (𝕜 : Type u_1) {E : Type u_2} [inst : RCLike.{u_1} 𝕜] [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup.{u_2} E]
  [inst_2 : InnerProductSpace.{u_1, u_2} 𝕜 E] [inst_3 : NormedSpace.{0, u_2} ℝ E] {f g : ℝ → E} {f' g' : E} {x : ℝ},
  HasDerivAt.{0, u_2} f f' x →
    HasDerivAt.{0, u_2} g g' x →
      HasDerivAt.{0, u_1} (fun t => inner.{u_1, u_2} 𝕜 (f t) (g t))
        (HAdd.hAdd.{u_1, u_1, u_1} (inner.{u_1, u_2} 𝕜 (f x) g') (inner.{u_1, u_2} 𝕜 f' (g x))) x
BEGIN_AXIOMS:M007
'HasDerivAt.inner' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice.{u}, Quot.sound.{u}]
